name: hcapp_setDirectoryVisibility
description: Records who may find the caller in hasher search (E9.F1.S26). Writes HC.Hasher.DirectoryVisibility ALONE, never updatedAt (not synced).

parameters.name: visibility
parameters.description: NULL not asked; low bits 0 nobody, 1 people I have run with, 2 members of a kennel I belong to, 3 anyone; +16 also findable by real name; the real-name flag is dropped with 0

rowsets.description: Auth failure returns the detail alone; other refusals return {success:0, errorCode, errorType} then the detail: 14200 bad value (2), 14201 unhandled (5)

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
